prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet", "Your pet progress and customization are backed up securely to your account across restarts.", "Cloud Backup Enabled", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
1: ["Finalize Your Desktop Pet's Official Certificate", "Choose a name and personality trait to seal your official desktop adoption paper.", "Name your pet...", "Personality Trait"]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Use quick shortcuts to interact, move, or hide your companion anytime.", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide", "Right-click the pet anytime to open the action wheel.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating custom assets and preparing your pet's desktop home.", "Generating pet animations...", "Desktop Renderer: Ready"]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Experience", "Pick quick adopt for instant play or custom companion to create your unique pet."]
5: ["Best results: clear lighting, front-facing pet, uncluttered background.", "Good lighting | Clear face | Single animal"]
6: ["Sign In & Unlock Exclusive Gold Crown Accessory", "Create or sign into your account to receive a free welcome gift for your pet.", "Free Gift: Royal Crown Unlocked"]
7: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion in Under 2 Minutes", "Bring an adorable animated pet to live right on your screen with quick, simple setup steps.", "Start Quick Setup"]
8: ["Checking display overlay permissions... Pet will land on your main taskbar when ready.", "Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen once loaded."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Click on your new friend to open the interaction menu or drag them around your monitor.", "Say hello to your new pet!", "Start Playing"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free gifts and exclusive items
